name: tokky
description: See your Tokky language-learning progress in ChatGPT, review the words you missed and find roleplay scenarios to practice.

interface.longDescription:
Tokky is a language-learning app with daily vocabulary, speaking and grammar sessions and AI roleplay conversations with the tutor Tokky. Connect your Tokky account so ChatGPT can see what you have learned and help you keep going.

What you can do
• Check your progress — streak, level per daily session (vocabulary, speaking, grammar), today's goal and study time.
• Review the words you got wrong in Tokky — ChatGPT can quiz you with the same example sentences.
• Look back at your recent roleplay conversations and the corrections Tokky gave you.
• Find Tokky roleplay scenarios for a situation you want to practice, then play them in the app.
• Change your daily goal or the wordbooks your vocabulary sessions draw from.

How connecting works
When you connect, you approve the connection in the Tokky app on your phone (tap the button, or scan the QR code on a computer) and check that the confirmation code matches. Tokky only shares your own learning record. You can disconnect at any time.

Limitations
Studying itself (daily sessions, speaking practice and roleplay) happens in the Tokky app. Connecting needs the latest version of the Tokky app.
capabilities: Quiz on words you got wrong
defaultPrompt: How is my Tokky learning going this week?
Quiz me on the words I got wrong in Tokky.
Find a Tokky roleplay for ordering at a café.

positive.description: Summarize the connected account's learning record: streak, per-track levels, today's progress and recent study time.
positive.prompt: How is my Tokky learning going? What's my streak?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reports the test account's current and longest streak, the level and today's answered/goal for each daily track (vocab, speaking, grammar) and the last 7 days of study time.

positive.description: Quiz the user on words they got wrong in Tokky, using Tokky's own example sentences.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on the words I got wrong in Tokky.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant lists or quizzes the test account's review words (fill-in-the-blank example sentences with meanings and translations) and checks the user's answers against the returned answer field.

positive.description: Look back at recent roleplay conversations and the corrections Tokky gave.
positive.prompt: What mistakes did I make in my recent Tokky roleplays?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant names the recent roleplay scenarios with missions completed and shows the user's sentences next to Tokky's corrected versions and notes.

positive.description: Find Tokky roleplay scenarios for a situation the user wants to practice.
positive.prompt: Find a Tokky roleplay for ordering coffee at a café.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant returns matching Tokky roleplay scenarios (titles and taglines in the user's language) and explains they can be played in the Tokky app's Roleplay tab.

positive.description: Change a study setting that is saved to the Tokky account.
positive.prompt: Set my Tokky daily vocabulary goal to 15 new words and 10 reviews.
positive.expected_behavior: The vocab track goal becomes 15 new + 10 review items (25 per day) and the assistant confirms the saved values; the next vocab session in the app uses them.

negative.description: Studying and logging progress happen in the Tokky app. The assistant must not claim to record a finished lesson or change the streak; it should explain this and point to the app.
negative.prompt: Mark today's Tokky lesson as done and add 5 days to my streak.

negative.description: Deleting the Tokky account is not something the app can do. The assistant should decline and not call any write tool.
The app only accesses the connected user's own learning record. The assistant should decline requests about other people's data.
negative.prompt: Show me my friend Alex's Tokky streak and wrong words.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: learning progress and streak, review words, roleplay history and search, daily goal and wordbook settings.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 토키 학습 기록을 보고 복습해요
ko-KR.description:
Tokky는 매일 단어·스피킹·문법 학습과 튜터 토키와의 AI 롤플레이 대화로 외국어를 배우는 앱입니다. Tokky 계정을 연결하면 ChatGPT가 지금까지 배운 내용을 보고 학습을 이어 가도록 도와줘요.

할 수 있는 일
• 학습 현황 확인 — 연속 학습일, 단어·스피킹·문법 트랙별 레벨, 오늘 목표와 공부 시간
• Tokky에서 틀렸던 단어 복습 — 같은 예문으로 ChatGPT가 퀴즈를 내 줘요
• 최근 롤플레이 대화와 토키가 고쳐 준 표현 다시 보기
• 연습하고 싶은 상황의 Tokky 롤플레이 찾기(대화는 앱에서)
• 하루 학습 목표와 공부할 단어장 바꾸기

연결 방법
연결할 때 휴대폰의 Tokky 앱에서 승인해요(폰은 버튼, 컴퓨터는 QR). 확인 코드가 같은지 확인해 주세요. Tokky는 내 학습 기록만 공유하고, 언제든 연결을 끊을 수 있어요.

제한
학습 자체(데일리 학습·스피킹·롤플레이)는 Tokky 앱에서 해요. 연결하려면 최신 버전의 Tokky 앱이 필요해요.

ja-JP.subtitle: Tokkyの学習記録を見て復習
ja-JP.description:
Tokkyは、毎日の単語・スピーキング・文法の学習と、チューターのトッキーとのAIロールプレイ会話で外国語を学べるアプリです。Tokkyアカウントを連携すると、ChatGPTがこれまでの学習内容を確認し、学習を続けるお手伝いをします。

できること
• 学習状況の確認 — 連続学習日数、単語・スピーキング・文法トラックごとのレベル、今日の目標と学習時間
• Tokkyで間違えた単語の復習 — 同じ例文でChatGPTがクイズを出します
• 最近のロールプレイ会話とトッキーが直してくれた表現の振り返り
• 練習したい場面のTokkyロールプレイを探す（会話はアプリで）
• 1日の学習目標と学習する単語帳の変更

連携方法
連携時にスマホのTokkyアプリで承認します（スマホはボタン、パソコンはQRコード）。確認コードが一致することを確認してください。Tokkyはあなたの学習記録だけを共有し、いつでも連携を解除できます。

制限
学習そのもの（デイリー学習・スピーキング・ロールプレイ）はTokkyアプリで行います。連携には最新バージョンのTokkyアプリが必要です。

zh-TW.subtitle: 查看 Tokky 學習紀錄並複習
zh-TW.description:
Tokky 是透過每日單字、口說、文法練習，以及與家教 Tokky 進行 AI 角色扮演對話來學習外語的 App。連結 Tokky 帳號後，ChatGPT 就能查看你學過的內容，陪你持續學下去。

你可以
• 查看學習狀況 — 連續學習天數、單字／口說／文法各軌道的等級、今日目標與學習時間
• 複習在 Tokky 答錯的單字 — ChatGPT 會用同樣的例句出題
• 回顧最近的角色扮演對話與 Tokky 幫你修正的說法
• 尋找想練習情境的 Tokky 角色扮演（對話在 App 中進行）
• 變更每日學習目標與要學習的單字本

連結方式
連結時請在手機的 Tokky App 中核准（手機點按鈕，電腦掃 QR Code），並確認確認碼相同。Tokky 只分享你的學習紀錄，你可以隨時中斷連結。

限制
學習本身（每日練習、口說、角色扮演）在 Tokky App 中進行。連結需要最新版本的 Tokky App。

zh-HK.subtitle: 查看 Tokky 學習記錄並溫習
zh-HK.description:
Tokky 是透過每日生字、口語、文法練習，以及與導師 Tokky 進行 AI 角色扮演對話來學習外語的 App。連結 Tokky 帳戶後，ChatGPT 就能查看你學過的內容，陪你繼續學下去。

你可以
• 查看學習進度 — 連續學習日數、生字／口語／文法各項目的等級、今日目標及學習時間
• 溫習在 Tokky 答錯的生字 — ChatGPT 會用同樣的例句出題
• 回顧最近的角色扮演對話及 Tokky 幫你修正的說法
• 尋找想練習情境的 Tokky 角色扮演（對話在 App 內進行）
• 更改每日學習目標及要學習的生字簿

連結方法
連結時請在手機的 Tokky App 內批准（手機按按鈕，電腦掃描 QR 碼），並確認確認碼相同。Tokky 只會分享你的學習記錄，你可以隨時中斷連結。

限制
學習本身（每日練習、口語、角色扮演）在 Tokky App 內進行。連結需要最新版本的 Tokky App。

es-ES.subtitle: Revisa tu progreso en Tokky
es-ES.description:
Tokky es una app para aprender idiomas con sesiones diarias de vocabulario, conversación y gramática, y conversaciones de roleplay con IA junto al tutor Tokky. Conecta tu cuenta de Tokky para que ChatGPT vea lo que has aprendido y te ayude a seguir.

Qué puedes hacer
• Consultar tu progreso: racha, nivel en cada sesión diaria (vocabulario, conversación, gramática), meta de hoy y tiempo de estudio.
• Repasar las palabras que fallaste en Tokky: ChatGPT puede ponerte a prueba con las mismas frases de ejemplo.
• Revisar tus conversaciones de roleplay recientes y las correcciones de Tokky.
• Buscar escenarios de roleplay de Tokky para la situación que quieras practicar (se juegan en la app).
• Cambiar tu meta diaria o los libros de vocabulario que estudias.

Cómo se conecta
Al conectar, apruebas la conexión en la app de Tokky de tu teléfono (toca el botón o escanea el código QR desde el ordenador) y compruebas que el código de confirmación coincide. Tokky solo comparte tu propio historial de aprendizaje y puedes desconectarte cuando quieras.

Limitaciones
El estudio en sí (sesiones diarias, práctica de conversación y roleplay) se hace en la app de Tokky. Para conectar necesitas la versión más reciente de la app.

fr-FR.subtitle: Suis ta progression Tokky
fr-FR.description:
Tokky est une app pour apprendre les langues avec des sessions quotidiennes de vocabulaire, d'expression orale et de grammaire, et des conversations de jeu de rôle avec l'IA et le tuteur Tokky. Connecte ton compte Tokky pour que ChatGPT voie ce que tu as appris et t'aide à continuer.

Ce que tu peux faire
• Voir ta progression : série, niveau de chaque session quotidienne (vocabulaire, oral, grammaire), objectif du jour et temps d'étude.
• Réviser les mots que tu as ratés dans Tokky : ChatGPT peut t'interroger avec les mêmes phrases d'exemple.
• Revoir tes conversations de jeu de rôle récentes et les corrections de Tokky.
• Trouver des jeux de rôle Tokky pour la situation que tu veux travailler (on y joue dans l'app).
• Modifier ton objectif quotidien ou les carnets de vocabulaire que tu étudies.

Comment se connecter
Pour te connecter, tu approuves la connexion dans l'app Tokky sur ton téléphone (bouton sur mobile, code QR sur ordinateur) et tu vérifies que le code de confirmation est identique. Tokky ne partage que ton propre historique d'apprentissage et tu peux te déconnecter à tout moment.

Limites
L'apprentissage lui-même (sessions quotidiennes, oral et jeux de rôle) se fait dans l'app Tokky. La connexion nécessite la dernière version de l'app.

de-DE.subtitle: Deinen Tokky-Lernstand ansehen
de-DE.description:
Tokky ist eine Sprachlern-App mit täglichen Sessions für Wortschatz, Sprechen und Grammatik sowie KI-Rollenspielgesprächen mit dem Tutor Tokky. Verbinde dein Tokky-Konto, damit ChatGPT sieht, was du gelernt hast, und dir beim Dranbleiben hilft.

Was du tun kannst
• Deinen Fortschritt prüfen: Serie, Level pro Tagessession (Wortschatz, Sprechen, Grammatik), heutiges Ziel und Lernzeit.
• Wörter wiederholen, die du in Tokky falsch hattest – ChatGPT kann dich mit denselben Beispielsätzen abfragen.
• Deine letzten Rollenspielgespräche und Tokkys Korrekturen ansehen.
• Tokky-Rollenspiele für eine Situation finden, die du üben willst (gespielt wird in der App).
• Dein Tagesziel oder die Wortlisten für deine Wortschatz-Sessions ändern.

So funktioniert das Verbinden
Beim Verbinden bestätigst du die Verbindung in der Tokky-App auf deinem Handy (Schaltfläche auf dem Handy, QR-Code am Computer) und prüfst, ob der Bestätigungscode übereinstimmt. Tokky teilt nur deinen eigenen Lernverlauf, und du kannst die Verbindung jederzeit trennen.

Einschränkungen
Das Lernen selbst (Tagessessions, Sprechübungen und Rollenspiele) findet in der Tokky-App statt. Zum Verbinden brauchst du die neueste Version der App.

tr-TR.subtitle: Tokky öğrenme kaydını gör
tr-TR.description:
Tokky; günlük kelime, konuşma ve dilbilgisi oturumları ve öğretmen Tokky ile yapay zekâ destekli rol yapma sohbetleriyle dil öğrenme uygulamasıdır. Tokky hesabını bağla; ChatGPT öğrendiklerini görsün ve devam etmene yardım etsin.

Neler yapabilirsin
• İlerlemeni gör: seri, her günlük oturumdaki seviye (kelime, konuşma, dilbilgisi), bugünkü hedef ve çalışma süresi.
• Tokky'de yanlış yaptığın kelimeleri tekrar et — ChatGPT aynı örnek cümlelerle seni test edebilir.
• Son rol yapma sohbetlerine ve Tokky'nin düzeltmelerine göz at.
• Çalışmak istediğin durum için Tokky rol yapma senaryoları bul (uygulamada oynanır).
• Günlük hedefini veya çalıştığın kelime defterlerini değiştir.

Bağlantı nasıl yapılır
Bağlanırken telefonundaki Tokky uygulamasında bağlantıyı onaylarsın (telefonda düğme, bilgisayarda QR kodu) ve onay kodunun aynı olduğunu kontrol edersin. Tokky yalnızca kendi öğrenme kaydını paylaşır ve bağlantıyı istediğin zaman kesebilirsin.

Sınırlamalar
Çalışmanın kendisi (günlük oturumlar, konuşma pratiği ve rol yapma) Tokky uygulamasında yapılır. Bağlanmak için Tokky uygulamasının en son sürümü gerekir.

vi-VN.subtitle: Xem tiến độ học trên Tokky
vi-VN.description:
Tokky là ứng dụng học ngoại ngữ với các buổi học từ vựng, nói và ngữ pháp mỗi ngày cùng những cuộc hội thoại nhập vai AI với gia sư Tokky. Kết nối tài khoản Tokky để ChatGPT xem bạn đã học những gì và giúp bạn học tiếp.

Bạn có thể
• Xem tiến độ: chuỗi ngày học, cấp độ của từng buổi học hằng ngày (từ vựng, nói, ngữ pháp), mục tiêu hôm nay và thời gian học.
• Ôn lại những từ bạn đã làm sai trên Tokky — ChatGPT có thể đố bạn bằng chính các câu ví dụ đó.
• Xem lại các cuộc hội thoại nhập vai gần đây và những chỗ Tokky đã sửa cho bạn.
• Tìm kịch bản nhập vai của Tokky cho tình huống bạn muốn luyện (chơi trong ứng dụng).
• Đổi mục tiêu hằng ngày hoặc sổ từ vựng bạn đang học.

Cách kết nối
Khi kết nối, bạn chấp thuận trong ứng dụng Tokky trên điện thoại (chạm nút trên điện thoại, quét mã QR trên máy tính) và kiểm tra mã xác nhận có giống nhau không. Tokky chỉ chia sẻ lịch sử học của chính bạn và bạn có thể ngắt kết nối bất cứ lúc nào.

Giới hạn
Việc học (buổi học hằng ngày, luyện nói và nhập vai) diễn ra trong ứng dụng Tokky. Cần phiên bản mới nhất của ứng dụng Tokky để kết nối.

th-TH.subtitle: ดูบันทึกการเรียน Tokky ของคุณ
th-TH.description:
Tokky คือแอปเรียนภาษาที่มีบทเรียนคำศัพท์ การพูด และไวยากรณ์ทุกวัน พร้อมบทสนทนาเล่นบทบาทสมมติกับ AI ร่วมกับติวเตอร์ Tokky เชื่อมต่อบัญชี Tokky เพื่อให้ ChatGPT เห็นสิ่งที่คุณเรียนไปแล้วและช่วยให้คุณเรียนต่อได้

สิ่งที่ทำได้
• ดูความคืบหน้า — สถิติเรียนต่อเนื่อง เลเวลของแต่ละบทเรียนรายวัน (คำศัพท์ การพูด ไวยากรณ์) เป้าหมายวันนี้ และเวลาเรียน
• ทบทวนคำที่คุณตอบผิดใน Tokky — ChatGPT ทำแบบทดสอบให้ด้วยประโยคตัวอย่างเดียวกันได้
• ย้อนดูบทสนทนาเล่นบทบาทสมมติล่าสุดและสำนวนที่ Tokky แก้ให้
• ค้นหาบทบาทสมมติของ Tokky สำหรับสถานการณ์ที่อยากฝึก (เล่นในแอป)
• เปลี่ยนเป้าหมายรายวันหรือสมุดคำศัพท์ที่คุณเรียน

วิธีเชื่อมต่อ
ตอนเชื่อมต่อ คุณจะอนุมัติในแอป Tokky บนโทรศัพท์ (แตะปุ่มบนมือถือ หรือสแกนคิวอาร์โค้ดบนคอมพิวเตอร์) และตรวจสอบว่ารหัสยืนยันตรงกัน Tokky แชร์เฉพาะบันทึกการเรียนของคุณเอง และคุณยกเลิกการเชื่อมต่อได้ทุกเมื่อ

ข้อจำกัด
การเรียนจริง (บทเรียนรายวัน การฝึกพูด และบทบาทสมมติ) ทำในแอป Tokky การเชื่อมต่อต้องใช้แอป Tokky เวอร์ชันล่าสุด

pt-BR.subtitle: Veja seu progresso no Tokky
pt-BR.description:
O Tokky é um app para aprender idiomas com sessões diárias de vocabulário, conversação e gramática, além de conversas de roleplay com IA ao lado do tutor Tokky. Conecte sua conta do Tokky para o ChatGPT ver o que você já aprendeu e ajudar você a continuar.

O que você pode fazer
• Ver seu progresso: sequência, nível em cada sessão diária (vocabulário, conversação, gramática), meta de hoje e tempo de estudo.
• Revisar as palavras que você errou no Tokky — o ChatGPT pode fazer um quiz com as mesmas frases de exemplo.
• Rever suas conversas de roleplay recentes e as correções do Tokky.
• Encontrar roleplays do Tokky para a situação que você quer praticar (jogados no app).
• Mudar sua meta diária ou os cadernos de vocabulário que você estuda.

Como funciona a conexão
Ao conectar, você aprova a conexão no app do Tokky no celular (botão no celular, QR code no computador) e confere se o código de confirmação é o mesmo. O Tokky compartilha apenas o seu próprio histórico de estudo e você pode desconectar quando quiser.

Limitações
O estudo em si (sessões diárias, conversação e roleplay) acontece no app do Tokky. Para conectar, é preciso a versão mais recente do app.

id-ID.subtitle: Lihat progres belajar Tokky-mu
id-ID.description:
Tokky adalah aplikasi belajar bahasa dengan sesi kosakata, berbicara, dan tata bahasa setiap hari, serta percakapan roleplay AI bersama tutor Tokky. Hubungkan akun Tokky kamu agar ChatGPT bisa melihat apa yang sudah kamu pelajari dan membantumu terus belajar.

Yang bisa kamu lakukan
• Cek progres: streak, level di tiap sesi harian (kosakata, berbicara, tata bahasa), target hari ini, dan waktu belajar.
• Ulangi kata yang salah kamu jawab di Tokky — ChatGPT bisa mengujimu dengan contoh kalimat yang sama.
• Lihat lagi percakapan roleplay terbaru dan koreksi dari Tokky.
• Cari skenario roleplay Tokky untuk situasi yang ingin kamu latih (dimainkan di aplikasi).
• Ubah target harian atau buku kosakata yang kamu pelajari.

Cara menghubungkan
Saat menghubungkan, kamu menyetujui koneksi di aplikasi Tokky di ponsel (ketuk tombol di ponsel, pindai kode QR di komputer) dan memastikan kode konfirmasinya sama. Tokky hanya membagikan riwayat belajarmu sendiri dan kamu bisa memutus koneksi kapan saja.

Batasan
Belajarnya sendiri (sesi harian, latihan berbicara, dan roleplay) dilakukan di aplikasi Tokky. Untuk menghubungkan, kamu perlu aplikasi Tokky versi terbaru.
